note: The RM277's seven configurations, transcribed from tools/cut-gunsmith-
granted.py when that script was generalised into cut-gunsmith-layouts.py.
The layouts it produced are already in data/gunsmith-rm277.json and this has
NOT been re-run against them: the frames live in a clips/ directory outside
the repo that no longer exists here. It is kept so the reading is recorded
rather than lost -- which clip fitted what, and which chips the label reader
could not place on its own -- and so a re-recording has something to start
from. A re-run would keep every anchor already in the file, so it would move

clips.why: The micro sight riser goes in a slot the tactical riser opened, so this clip has both parts on and its layout answers for both.

The modular grip's card prints Grip Mount under Conflicting Slots and this clip was cut believing that mattered. It cannot: the mount is opened by a DIFFERENT rear grip, so no build has both. The conflict is out of the rules and out of this layout, which is what was really watched -- nothing was removed here, because nothing was there to remove.
Filed under the muzzle brake but fits an Insight 3/7, whose card prints "Adds Slots: Killflash" -- the rule arrived at from the footage rather than from the rules file.
